Title: Stand-in Tier+Tactical Explosive 2
Author: Blockland ReImagined tests
Written for tests. It has the community Weapon_Package_Explosive2 folder
name, the method names its port covers and the shape of its scripts, built
on the stand-in Tier 1 as the original is built on Tier 1, so the listed
port applies to it. It is not the original Add-On and holds none of its
files, and its launchers, sounds and numbers are its own.
